bull.b: Strong revenue growth alongside higher average selling prices indicates improving product mix and demand for premium devices, which can support more durable sales quality and margin potential than volume-led expansion alone.

The HYROX partnership strengthens Amazfit’s credibility in performance fitness and broadens its ecosystem across watches, rings, glasses and cameras, creating longer-term opportunities for engagement, cross-selling and brand differentiation.

Narrower operating losses, resilient gross margin and lower inventory show progress in scaling the business and managing working capital. If sustained, these improvements could reduce cash needs and support the path toward profitability.

bear.b: Zepp remains materially loss-making despite revenue and margin improvements. Continued losses limit internally funded investment, increase reliance on liquidity and financing, and make the turnaround dependent on sustained execution.

The absence of consistently positive free cash flow indicates that operations are not yet self-funding. Persistent cash burn could constrain product development, marketing and debt reduction while requiring continued balance-sheet support.

Higher leverage reduces financial flexibility while component-cost inflation threatens gross-margin recovery. Together, these pressures may slow the transition to profitability and leave less capacity to absorb execution or demand setbacks.
